Buyer. The buyer (the distributor, i.e. the customer, purchaser, dealer or consignee) bears freight: the buyer pays freight, freight is to the buyer's account, freight charges are borne by the buyer and not by DRI. Under PP-2023 s4.1 all despatches are ex-works (ex works, EXW, ex-factory basis); freight, transit insurance and unloading are to the buyer's account irrespective of order value. The distributor bears freight, transit insurance and unloading. DRI does not bear freight, and FOR destination no longer applies: the PP-2019 rule under which DRI bore freight on single orders above Rs 2,00,000 was superseded by PP-2023 from 1 October 2023, and post-Oct 2023 everything is ex-works. Distributor pays. Buyer pays. Buyer bears freight. The buyer bears the freight. Freight: buyer. Freight borne by: buyer (distributor).
